how: https://www.vals.ai/benchmarks/emb Astro island BenchmarkView props (html-escaped JSON) -> benchmarkView.default.tasks.overall[model_key] = {accuracy, latency, cost_per_test}; effort = per-row compute_effort|reasoning_effort from the same props (fallback: model registry default_parameters in /_astro/constants.BzMCAmxE.js, then data/vals_index.csv); labels from that registry. score = accuracy (%), cost = mean $ per test; see cost_audit for denominator evidence.

cost_audit.evidence: Dataset: 51 held-out questions in both Template and Scratch modes. Overall cost averages the two modes; 51 x 2 = 102 executions.
